title: Degree-zero restriction to a closed subset of a spectral space (sheaves of sets)
statement: Let $X$ be a spectral space [def-weil-spectral-space] and let $Z\subseteq X$ be a closed subset such that for every $x\in X$ the intersection $Z\cap\overline{\{x\}}$ is connected [def-weil-connected-scheme] (in particular nonempty). Let $\mathcal F$ be a sheaf of sets on $X$ (a functor from the open subsets of $X$, ordered by inclusion, to sets, satisfying the gluing condition for every open covering), and let $\mathcal F|_Z$ be its inverse image along the inclusion $i:Z\to X$: the sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification] $\theta:i_p\mathcal F\to\mathcal F|_Z$ of the presheaf $i_p\mathcal F:U\mapsto\varinjlim_{V\supseteq U}\mathcal F(V)$ on $Z$ ($V$ open in $X$, colimit [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] of sets over the directed set of such $V$ ordered by reverse inclusion, coprojections $\iota^U_V$), i.e. the construction of [def-weil-pbc-topological-inverse-image] (2), (3) with values in sets. Then the restriction map $\Gamma(X,\mathcal F)\to\Gamma(Z,\mathcal F|_Z)$, $s\mapsto\theta_Z(\iota^Z_X(s))$ (the component at $X$ of the unit $\mathcal F\to i_*(\mathcal F|_Z)$), is bijective.

proof.text: For injectivity, equality of restricted sections gives equality of germs at each z in Z by the proved private germ-comparison helper, obtained from Mathlib stalkPullbackIso, stalkFunctor_map_unit_toSheafify_isIso, and compatibility of the abstract and constructed pullback adjunction units via Adjunction.unit_leftAdjointUniq_hom_app. Connectedness supplies z in Z ∩ closure {x} for every x. Equal germs at z give equal restrictions on a neighbourhood W of z by Mathlib germ_eq. Specialization implies x is in W. Applying the germ map at x gives equality of germs at x, and Mathlib section_ext gives equality of the original global sections.
Combine this injectivity with the surjectivity component, which carries Steps 2-5 of the original argument, using Function.Bijective = Injective ∧ Surjective.
